# Cloudrave v1.0.0-beta.4

Cloudrave beta.4 combines the backend and frontend releases. The published binaries bundle the exact frontend commit recorded in `.frontend-ref`.

## Supported

- Storage: local filesystem, Tencent COS, Aliyun OSS, China Mobile 139 Cloud Drive, China Telecom 189 Cloud Drive, and China Unicom Wo Cloud.
- File operations: browse, create folders, rename, move, copy, recycle-bin restore, permanent deletion, archive download, and sharing.
- Uploads: browser multipart upload, resumable sessions, checksum-aware carrier uploads, and automatic Cloudrave relay when supported carrier direct uploads fail because of browser network or CORS restrictions.
- Downloads: signed object-store links, native carrier downloads, and share-download probes.
- Preview and edit: image, video, audio, PDF, Office, text, Markdown, and archive preview; text/Markdown save, PDF annotations, and image export.
- Accounts and administration: JWT/refresh sessions, TOTP, Passkey/WebAuthn, linked OAuth providers, admin/user/guest permissions, storage mounts, quotas, and database migration tools.

## Notes

- Carrier-drive features depend on valid user credentials and the provider's current service and account permissions.
- Relayed upload parts and carrier object copies pass through the Cloudrave server. Configure sufficient request-size limits, bandwidth, and temporary disk capacity.
- Office files are preview-only; collaborative Office editing is not included.
- This is a prerelease. Back up the database and keep the previous release available before upgrading.
